bullets.text: In Tiruvallur district, a 21-year-old engineering student was arrested for trying to set a college bus on fire with students inside; the office should monitor student safety.
Near Ambattur in Chennai, a young man died after falling with his bike into an open rainwater drain pit; the office must ensure proper warning signs and lights.
The collector warned Thiruvallur fishermen not to go out to sea due to a possible low pressure area in the Bay of Bengal; the office should watch safety advisories.
The Tamil Nadu government will establish 12 mini taluk offices in Chennai for Rs 2.14 crore; the office should track revenue service access improvements for residents.
Chennai District Election Officer G.S. Sameeran released the draft electoral roll showing 29.15 lakh voters; the office should monitor voter registration updates.
In Ponneri, politician Tamilisai Soundararajan criticized the state's law and order situation; the office should note political reactions regarding safety.
The Tirutani Murugan Temple is hosting the fourth day of the Kandha Sashti festival; the office should monitor crowd management and event arrangements.
The Greater Chennai Traffic Police are introducing an Edge AI project to monitor parking violations; the office should watch traffic and technology implementation.
Tamil Nadu telecom officials seized two SIM boxes with 64-card capacities and arrested cyber criminals; the office should track cybercrime investigations.
Public money bought Tamil Nadu library books allegedly written using AI tools; the office should review procurement policies and the quality of library materials.
